text: This report responds to City Council Motion (MM8.28) dated July 19, 2023. It was requested that Toronto Emergency Management, in consultation with Toronto Fire Services and Toronto Paramedic Services, assess the risks faced by Toronto residents living near Highway 401 from transportation incidents.
The Infrastructure and Environment Committee: 1. Deferred the consideration of this item until the September 27, 2024, meeting of the Infrastructure and Environment Committee.
